PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.5.438
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/6.5.438
Project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache 2.0 (see LICENSE)

Self-hosted browser text-extraction library and worker, with character maps and
standard fonts. Resume bytes are passed directly to the local worker; documents
are not uploaded to a parsing service. No PDF JavaScript is executed.
